We reviewed the prospects for joint cooperation between our two friendly countries in the military and defense field, and discussed current developments in the region in light of the continued sinful Iranian attacks on the Kingdom and a number of countries in the region, and their repercussions on international peace and security.

I met with His Excellency British Defense Minister John Healey.
We reviewed the strategic defense partnership between our two friendly countries and the opportunities for its development. screenshots.name: Mohammed AlJabir
tweets: #Al-Hudaydah is liberated.....#Yemen is breathing

In continuation of the Kingdom’s efforts to end the Yemeni crisis and in support of the initiative presented by the Kingdom in 2021 AD, I will visit Sana’a, in the presence of a delegation from the sister Sultanate of Oman, with the aim of consolidating the truce and ceasefire, supporting the prisoner exchange process, and discussing ways of dialogue between the Yemeni components to reach a comprehensive and sustainable political solution in Yemen.
